answer: Use a newcomer passport backed by three-signer fraud bonds. Three established members verify an entrant with a live challenge and co-sign one passport. It activates after 30 days; each signer locks 40 tokens. A fraud vote on duplicate accounts revokes the passport and slashes all three bonds. Ten fakes tie up 1,200 tokens for 30 days and need 30 willing signers, plus active accounts through review. Ivory, yarrow, and lotus are randomly selected challenge words, never credentials. It is a guarded bridge: every traveler crosses as three sentries risk their wages.
